claim: Web Summit started in Dublin in 2009.
In 2010, Web Summit was a meet-up for about 400 people, according to Wikipedia.
Web Summit moved to Lisbon in 2016, when 53,056 people attended.
Web Summit 2025 had a record 71,386 attendees from 157 countries, according to the organisers as reported by AICEP.
Web Summit 2025 had 1,857 investors and 2,725 startups.
The agreement to hold Web Summit in Lisbon runs to 2028, as reported by Lusa.
The Lisbon hosting agreement was made in 2018 and covers every year from 2019 to 2028.
Portugal Tech Week opened on 6 November and runs to 15 November, according to its own site.
The PTW Palace, Portugal Tech Week's main venue, opens on 9 November.
Web Summit went online in 2020 and returned to Parque das Nações in 2021.
